name: Tsutsumi Airi
source:
Friends with Fumika since grade school.
She often visited her to play.
She is dependable, as she listens to Fumika's problems and gives advice.
She likes to have fun, but she's not that good at studies.
She thinks of Yuuma as her own brother.
She tends to always get involved with fun things, so she loves having sex.
